title: Playboy Magazine Lot 1972 Lingerie 1991 + 1 Random Magazine
descriptionText:
Description

Lot of 4 vintage Playboy magazines/special editions. Includes three original 1972 Playboy issues plus a 1991 Playboy’s Book of Lingerie.

Included:

* Playboy — March 1972
* Playboy — September 1972
* Playboy — October 1972
* Playboy’s Book of Lingerie — September/October 1991

The 1972 magazines show vintage wear including cover rubbing/scuffing, edge and corner wear, and other age-related handling. Please review all photos carefully for condition.

All four magazines pictured are included and sold together. 1 random magazine included.
